bracu_official.title: ADMISSIONS OPEN: ONLY ONE UG INTAKE FOR SPRING 2027
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University has announced that there will be only one undergraduate intake for Spring 2027. This is a crucial notice for prospective students planning their applications.

bracu_official.title: Health minister lauds BRAC University for launching MSc in Medical Physics
bracu_official.summary: The health minister has praised BRAC University for initiating its new MSc in Medical Physics program. This launch signifies a significant academic advancement for the university.

bracu_official.title: Law alumnus receives Australian government’s PhD scholarship
bracu_official.summary: A BRAC University Law alumnus has been awarded a prestigious PhD scholarship by the Australian government. This highlights the global academic success of the university's graduates.

bracu_official.title: Admission Test for Certificate Courses
bracu_official.summary: An admission test for various certificate courses is scheduled to take place on October 30th, 2026. This is an important upcoming date for all applicants.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University, IDCOL partner to build Bangladesh's energy and infrastructure workforce
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University has formed a partnership with IDCOL to collaboratively develop Bangladesh's workforce in the energy and infrastructure sectors. This initiative aims to address critical national development needs.

bracu_official.title: LLB Mid Term schedule for Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: The schedule for the LLB program's mid-term examinations for the Fall 2026 semester has been released. Students are advised to check the new timetable promptly.

bracu_official.title: Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami) - University Closed
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University will observe a holiday on October 20th, 2026, for Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami). The university will be closed on this day.

bracu_official.title: Semester/Course Withdraw With W Grade (No Refund)
bracu_official.summary: October 17th, 2026, is the deadline for semester or course withdrawal with a 'W' grade, with no refund available. Students considering withdrawal should take action by this date.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University to Host Second Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed Memorial International Moot Court Competition 2026
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University is preparing to host its second Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed Memorial International Moot Court Competition in 2026. This prestigious event will gather legal minds from various institutions.

bracu_official.title: Class Schedule for Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: The official class schedule for the Fall 2026 semester has been released. Students should consult it immediately for their course timings and locations.

bracu_official.title: Final Examinations
bracu_official.summary: Final examinations are scheduled to commence on December 10th, 2026. Students are encouraged to begin their preparation accordingly.

bracu_official.title: Mid-Term Exams week
bracu_official.summary: The university has designated the week of November 21st, 2026, for mid-term examinations. Students should review their course materials in advance.
